svg.aria-label: Two real upload shapes: a week of stacked tables in one sheet, and a single session with no date column — and what each did to the product.

g.text: WHAT THE FILES ACTUALLY LOOKED LIKE

svg.text: two uploads, drawn from the real ones
SHEET A — ONE WEEK, TABLES INSIDE TABLES
SHEET B — ONE SESSION, NO DATE ANYWHERE
any shape I had not anticipated bounced at the door
a year of sessions computed before anything drew
